cc:Work.dc:title: Integrated hyperparameter posterior
cc:Work.dc:description: Posterior density per unit log length and log noise, obtained by dividing posterior node masses by quadrature integration weights. Fixed and empirical-Bayes settings are marked; axes show positive length and noise on log scales.
